title: Clawd X Digest
summary: AI Price Wars & Frontier Models: OpenAI slashes prices for GPT-5.6 Luna by 80% and Terra by 20%, while Greg Brockman reflects on human-agent interaction dynamics in Slack.

Humanoid Robotics & AI Workflow Tricks: Unitree unveils the AS2-W Super Athlete humanoid, Victor Taelin shares 20-minute reasoning trace recycling tricks, and Marcos Hernanz publishes a 60B-token AGENTS.md system.

Markets & Leasing Mechanics: Tech analysts break down Apple's zero-fee Mac leasing economics, while market watchers debate 0DTE options risks and Sam Altman responds to Musk's 2036 post-scarcity forecast.
Culture, Media & Sports: Germany celebrates dual World Cup & EuroBasket basketball titles, James Gunn previews the new Superman cast, and viral creators showcase 2026 video aesthetics.

items.title: @OpenAI: 80% Price Reduction for GPT-5.6 Luna & Terra
items.body: OpenAI announced major price cuts across its frontier model lineup, dropping GPT-5.6 Luna pricing by 80% and GPT-5.6 Terra by 20%, while boosting execution speeds for GPT-5.6 Sol in the API.

items.title: @gdb: Human Relationships vs. Automated Slack Agents
items.body: Greg Brockman shared insights from internal OpenAI workflows, noting that employees dislike when coworkers' automated ChatGPT agents message them directly for tasks—reinforcing that AI should enhance human collaboration rather than act as a barrier.

items.title: @UnitreeRobotics: Unitree AS2-W Super Athlete Humanoid
items.body: Unitree unveiled the AS2-W humanoid robot featuring fluid movement, a continuous 16kg payload capacity, and over 30km of operating range.

items.title: @jenzhuscott: Navigating the DeepSeek Model Kill Zone
items.body: Jen Zhu Scott analyzed the competitive landscape for LLM providers, warning that inferior and expensive models face an immediate survival crisis as top-tier labs drive inference costs down.

items.title: @VictorTaelin: Reasoning Trace Recycling Prompt Trick
items.body: Taelin shared a novel prompt engineering technique: let a reasoning model think for 20 minutes on a complex problem, abort right before final output, and feed its own detailed thinking trace back into a fresh prompt for self-critique.

items.title: @MarcosHernanz: 60B-Token AGENTS.md Architecture
items.body: Marcos Hernanz published his complete AGENTS.md workflow system refined across 60 billion tokens of agentic execution.

items.title: @muellerberndt: OPH Lean 4 Proofs for Spacetime & Quantum Physics
items.body: Bernhard Mueller launched OPH, an open auditable repository utilizing Lean 4 formal proofs and simulations to explore observer-driven spacetime and physics models.

items.title: @VadimYuryev: Breakdown of Mac Zero-Interest Lease Economics
items.body: Vadim Yuryev analyzed Apple's 36-month zero-interest hardware lease structure for $2,999 M5 Pro MacBooks, explaining payoff windows, monthly cash flows, and resale value strategy.

items.title: @Hedgeye: 0DTE Options Risks in Volatile Markets
items.body: Market analysts highlighted warnings from former hedge fund managers regarding high-volume 0DTE (zero days to expiration) options accelerating rapid market selloffs.

items.title: @Adams_Tech_AI: Sam Altman Responds to Elon Musk on 2036 Economy
items.body: Sam Altman addressed Elon Musk's prediction that money will become obsolete by 2036 due to universal AI and robotics production capacity.

items.title: @1stForAll: Legal Challenges Over Pentagon Press Access
items.body: Freedom Forum reported on ongoing legal disputes surrounding Department of Defense newsgathering policies and press credentials.

items.title: @EuroWynner: Germany Holds Dual World Cup & EuroBasket Titles
items.body: Sports analysts celebrated Germany's historic basketball run, holding both the FIBA World Cup and EuroBasket championship titles simultaneously.

items.title: @BuzzFeedCeleb: First Look at James Gunn's Superman Cast
items.body: BuzzFeed spotlighted director James Gunn alongside cast members David Corenswet, Rachel Brosnahan, and Nicholas Hoult ahead of the upcoming Superman premiere.

items.title: @DerekFeehrer: Next-Gen Screen Recording & UI Aesthetics
items.body: Derek Feehrer showcased high-fidelity presentation techniques and motion-graphics standards for product demos in 2026.

items.title: @jiangyelab1: Capital Accumulation & Systems Building
items.body: A viral essay revisited core career strategy, framing early life as capital accumulation and later life as building scalable, automated systems.
